import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Torgerson': 'Torgersen', 'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    
    # Fix sex label variants (case normalization)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric if needed
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert year to numeric if needed
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Filter out out_of_range body_mass_g values (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    
    # Group by species and calculate mean body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    
    return result
